english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for beginning or initiating something, including saying where something begins.
This is the all-purpose choice for beginning an activity or undertaking.
Use this as the all-purpose choice when institute means to begin an activity, process, or undertaking.
Use this when “go” gives permission or an instruction to begin an action or process.
